decisionsTitle: Every line of the elite list has a number: given by itself when none is typed, one press for the lines without one, and a box to change it (amending §895, §903 and §986)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-19, from his phone, two days before Saturday's race (2026-11-21), with a screenshot of «Ziua cursei» → «Cronometrare» → «Elite»:** Adrian, Delia, Luisa, Paul, Silviu and Viorel as blue buttons, and «Ingrid» greyed with «Fără număr: un Administrator îi pune unul pe lista de elită (pe BIB tot nu se tipărește). Până atunci, notează-i timpul pe hârtie.» — «de ce apare Ingrid separat?» … «vreau să apară la fel! și să o pot cronometra» — *why is Ingrid apart? I want her to appear the same, and to be able to time her.*

**Why the finish line needs a number.** «Cronometrare» (§986) keys everything by a race number: a press, its duplicates, «Anulează», «Istoricul sosirilor» and the stored result (`event_results.bib_number` is required, one row a number). A line of the race's elite list (§895) stored its number as *optional* — and «Mută pe lista de elită» (§903) always wrote none — so a line without one was drawn grey with a note and could not be timed: its time went on paper. The elite bib prints the label alone and never the number (§963, §975), so the number is the line's own key — at the finish line, in the results, in «Participant #…», and beside the name under «Elitele cursei» for a line ticked «Apare pe site» — and giving every line one changes nothing printed.

**Decision — every line gets a number, by one rule (amending §895 and §903).**

- **The rule** (`bibs.ts#pickEliteLineNumber`): **the next free number of the race's own series, as the next confirmation would draw it** — from the race's first number up, the lowest one that nobody at the event wears, wore or holds (every registration's, a cancelled one's and a number held before §548 included; every other line's; every volunteer's; the erased, replaced and deleted ones; the numbers a print of spares stepped over — `numbersInUse`), that no stored result carries (a runner typed on «Clasament» under a number no registration holds would otherwise become the line's row, `hors-concours.ts` rule 3), and that is none of the desk's spares (§444). Unlike a confirmation it never runs past the race's series: it stays below the hidden list's own series when that sits above the race's (`seriesBounds`, §647) — never inside it — and at most 99 999. No number left there is refused in words (`ELITE_NO_FREE_NUMBER`), nothing written: the club types one.
- **Why this rule.** It is the allocator's own draw, over the same set of numbers taken and under the same lock, so it is safe by the argument that makes every runner's number safe, and it lands where runners' numbers are. «One above the highest number anybody has» was weighed and refused: one high number decides it for everybody — the volunteers' series at 500 would put the elites inside it (after which «Numerele voluntarilor încep de la», which must sit above every runner's number and so above every line's, could not be saved again), and a preferential number typed at 99 999 would leave no number at all.
- **Nobody else's, then or later.** The draw runs in the write's own transaction under the event row's lock, the one every number at an event is drawn under (`AGENTS.md` §10.6); and from the write on, every draw and every typed number reads the line's number as worn (`wornNumbers`, `bibNumberInUse`, as since §895): a confirmation's and «Alocă numerele»'s, the hidden list's, a volunteer's, the print of spares and its extension, the desk's box and its suggestions. A test holds each; on real connections (`tests/concurrency/elite-line-numbers.test.ts`) eight names added at once get eight numbers, and a line, a confirmation and two one-press numberings pressed together never share one.
- **Where.** «Adaugă pe lista de elită» with «Număr (opțional)» left empty draws one in the add's transaction, and its help now says so; «Mută pe lista de elită» (§903, amending its «no number») draws one the same way. A typed number keeps every check of §895. The trail gains `event_elite.number_given` — the line's id and the number, never the name.

**Decision — the lines left without one, in one press (amending §986).**

- **On «Cronometrare»,** in the grey button's place, **«Dă-i un număr»** — a button as tall as every elite's, the label large and «Dă-i un număr · <full name>» under it — for whoever writes the elite list: the Administrator (`canManageRegistrations`), asserted at the action's door (`giveEliteNumberFormAction`) and again in the service (`giveEliteLineNumber`, BR-REQ-060-01). One plain form beside the elites' (forms cannot nest), working without scripts; back on the page, «Ingrid (#N) are acum număr: se cronometrează ca celelalte elite.» / “Ingrid (#N) now has a number: timed like the other elites.” and the line's button the same blue button as every other elite's, pressed by its number and recorded as §986 records a line — a typed row with the line's name. A line a colleague numbered first is answered with its number, nothing written. Every other desk role keeps the note, unchanged.
- **On the elite card,** **«Dă număr elitelor fără număr (N)»** while N > 0 numbers them all, in the order typed, all or none (`giveEliteNumbers`); a line without a number says «fără număr». A press that finds none says so, nothing written.
- Each audited `event_elite.number_given` (`{ entryId, bibNumber }`). A numberless line out of the ranking matched its typed result by name (§910 rule 4), which a number ends: the race's stored results are ranked again in the same transaction, and the line's «Număr» box can take that row's number to keep it the line's.

**Decision — a line's «Număr» box.** On the elite card, under «Eticheta pe BIB», each line has «Număr» and «Salvează» (44 pixels, a small form of its own beside the event's save form, the numeric keypad), the Administrator's: the same checks as a number typed at the add — refused «Numărul acesta e deja folosit la eveniment…» when somebody has, had or holds it or it is a desk spare —, a whole number from 1 to 99 999 and never empty, since a line keeps a number; and refused while a result — «Sosit» or a decision of «Clasament» — is stored on the line's present number (`ELITE_NUMBER_HAS_RESULT`, «… care și-ar pierde alergătorul»: the finish line and «Clasament» keep a result by its number; «Clasament» corrects it first). Under the event row's lock, the one every finish press takes too. Audited `event_elite.number_set` with `{ entryId, from, to }`; the same number writes nothing. The Organizer reads «nr. N» or «fără număr» and has no box.

**The bib still prints only the label** (§963, §975): no drawing changed. The number shows where a line's number always showed: the card, the registrations list's «Elite» fold, «Ultimii sosiți», «Clasament», and «Elitele cursei» for a line the club put on the site with the person's agreement.

**No migration** — `event_elite_entries.bib_number` exists; a line written before this keeps none until «Dă-i un număr», which is why both presses exist.

**Refused.** «One above the highest number» (above). Numbering the old lines when a page is drawn — a page's read never writes; the press is one tap. Emptying a line's number — the finish line would lose it. A number for a registration marked «Elită» that has none: it draws its own at confirmation (§548), and its note on «Cronometrare» stays. A series of the elites' own (say 1–20): nobody asked for one, and a series needs a start the club sets and keeps clear, where the race's next number needs nothing.

**Not done.** Retiring a deleted line's number: deleting still frees it (§895) — a line's draw steps over any number a stored result carries, but a runner's draw does not read the results.
changelogLine: - **Every elite is timed on «Cronometrare»** — a name added to the elite list without a number now gets the race's next free one by itself (nobody else's, and still not printed on the bib); «Dă-i un număr» on «Cronometrare» and «Dă număr elitelor fără număr» on the elite card number the names left without one in one press, so «Ingrid» is a blue button like every other elite and her finish is recorded; and each name's «Număr» can be changed on the card until a result is stored on it. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 106. Given a line written onto «Elită — doar numele pe BIB» with «Număr (opțional)» empty, or moved there by «Mută pe lista de elită», then in the same transaction, under the event row's lock, it draws the race's next free number — the lowest from the race's first number that no registration of the event wears or wore (a cancelled one's, one held before the confirmation, an erased or replaced one included), no other line and no volunteer holds or held, no stored result carries and no desk spare is, below the hidden list's own series when that sits above the race's and at most 99999 — and the trail holds `event_elite.number_given` with the line's id and the number, never the name; with none left it is refused (`ELITE_NO_FREE_NUMBER`) on the number's box and nothing is written; a typed number keeps criterion 106's checks; and every later draw — a confirmation's, «Alocă numerele» in the race's and the hidden list's series, a volunteer's, the print of spares and its extension, the desk's box and its suggestions — steps over a line's number; on real connections, names added at once, a confirmation's draw and the one-press numbering pressed together never give two people one number. Verification: integration `registrations/elite-line-numbers.test.ts`, `registrations/elite-list.test.ts`, `registrations/elite-actions.test.ts`, `registrations/reserve-to-elite.test.ts`; concurrency `elite-line-numbers.test.ts` (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a line of the race's elite list without a number, then the elite card says «fără număr» on it and offers the Administrator «Dă număr elitelor fără număr (N)», N the lines without one, drawn only while N > 0, which gives each of them — in the order typed, all or none — the race's next free number by the rule above, one `event_elite.number_given` row a line; and every line carries, for the Administrator only, a box «Număr» with «Salvează», 44 pixels, posting a small form of its own beside the event's save form, which stores a whole number from 1 to 99999 with the add's checks — refused with its own sentence, nothing written, for a number somebody at the event has, had or holds or a desk spare, for an empty or malformed box, and while a result is stored on the line's present number (`ELITE_NUMBER_HAS_RESULT`) — writes `event_elite.number_set` with the line's id and the old and new numbers, and writes nothing for the number it already holds; the stored results are ranked again after either press; every other role is refused at the action and in the service; and the elite bib still prints only the label, never the number. Verification: unit `content/bib-print-card.test.ts`, `registrations/elite-bibs.test.ts`; integration `registrations/elite-line-numbers.test.ts`, `registrations/elite-actions.test.ts`, `results/elite-hors-concours.test.ts` (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 287 for an elite line with no number. Given «Cronometrare» drawn for an Administrator, then a line of the race's elite list without a number is drawn, in the grey button's place, as «Dă-i un număr» — at least 56 pixels tall, the bib's label large and «Dă-i un număr · <full name>» under it — a submit of one plain form of its own beside the elites' form, posting the line's id; pressed, with scripts on or off, the line gets the race's next free number, the page comes back with «<label> (#N) are acum număr: se cronometrează ca celelalte elite.» and draws the line as the same enabled button as every other elite's, whose press records «Sosit» as a typed row with the line's name and number; a line numbered meanwhile is answered with its number and nothing written; for every other role the line stays disabled with its note, and the action and the service refuse them. Verification: integration `results/timing-page.test.ts`, `results/finish.test.ts`, `registrations/elite-actions.test.ts`; e2e `race-finish-quick.spec.ts` (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: every line of the elite list has a number, so «Cronometrare» times every elite the same
